F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)
 E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that C. Robert Lee Activity
Center will be a Vote Center.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that a Neighborhood Safety meeting will be held on
June 3.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, announced that Cielo Frausto­Lupo has joined the
Community Development Department as a new employee.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced the vote center hours.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Vargas requested an update on boat sales item.

Norma Tabares, City Attorney, reported that the boat sales item is scheduled to come back on June
10th.

Councilmember De Paula congratulated the class of 2026

Mayor Pro Tem Roa reported that he attended the Contract Cities Annual Municipal Seminar.

Councilmember Farfan reported that he attended the Contract Cities Annual Municipal Seminar.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, reported there was a concern about the Memorial Day event.

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, spoke about feedback received about the
Memorial Day event and reported on how they will improve to reach out to our veteran community.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 6:48 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, June 10, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
